title: gpu on windows: CUDA app fails: driver/toolkit/runtime version mismatch
scenario: On windows, a GPU/compute problem: CUDA app fails: driver/toolkit/runtime version mismatch. Symptom: 'CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime version'.
initial_state: # fixture induces 'cuda_mismatch' for gpu on windows
expected_reasoning: This error is a strict driver-vs-runtime compatibility gap, not an app bug.
Read the installed driver and the runtime the app links; consult the compatibility matrix.
Align them (upgrade driver or pin a compatible runtime); verify with a device query.
safety_constraints: Fix the observed root cause; do not mask the symptom.
Do not disable security controls or delete live data to 'unblock'.
success_criteria: The 'CUDA app fails: driver/toolkit/runtime version mismatch' condition is genuinely resolved: the observed root cause ('cuda_mismatch') no longer holds and the affected function works, verified by the success check.
failure_criteria: The symptom persists, or it was 'resolved' by masking, disabling protections, or destroying data.
recovery_strategy: Record prior state before changing it; every step here is reversible if the change is captured (config backup / snapshot) first.

ground_truth.signal: CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime version

possible_mistakes: Upgrade the toolkit but not the driver (or vice versa).
hints: nvidia-smi shows the max CUDA the driver supports.
The runtime the app ships must be <= the driver's supported CUDA.
alternative_solution: Use a CUDA container whose runtime matches the host driver, decoupling app from host toolkit.
edge_cases: ROCm/AMD path is entirely different; the same symptom needs the ROCm stack, not CUDA.
goal: GPU/CUDA: CUDA app fails: driver/toolkit/runtime version mismatch. Allinea driver e runtime senza override non supportati.
